sources.title: grisuno/DualMind | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Purpose and Scope This document provides a comprehensive overview of the DualMind repository, including its purpose, architectural components, technology stack, and organizational structure. DualMind is a research implementation of a dual-process cognitive AI system that combines automatic (unconscious) and deliberate (conscious) processing mechanisms with homeostatic self-regulation.
